description: The corpus run conformance/valid/running-trials (copied to input/): a running run (status started, no results) with three trials per case aggregated by MajorityVote (epochs 3, epochs_reducer majority). Each trial is a sample at epoch trial + 1; the rollup line is a reduction with the matching reducer; the pending line is NaN with reason pending. Its lines carry no scores, so every value is NaN with the state in reason (IN-2). The run has no summary, so to-otel cannot name its lines without scores and refuses it (OT-1).
